blog/2026/2026-07-04-2026-07-04-job-sees: Cain was a fugitive, always running from justice, yet he “perished also in the fury wherewith he murdered his brother.” The judgment caught up with Cain, and it will catch up with his descendants, who have not yet paid for their crimes.

blog/2026/2026-07-04-2026-07-04-woe-to-a: Lot’s wife looked back at a destroyed city because something there still held her. “Remember Lot’s wife” warns us in this truth not to look back, stop trying to please everybody and stay away from filthiness, or be destroyed as she was.
blog/2026/2026-07-18-2026-07-18-as-in-th: Every people “did wonderful things,” meaning evil, and Cain’s line led the way: Jubal handled the harp, music, and Tubal-cain made brass and iron, weapons. Cain held power over entertainment and warfare, and nothing is new under the sun.

blog/2026/2026-07-18-2026-07-18-the-colo: Some claim the Israelites are nowhere in the community, but like the forefathers who “went about throughout all the cities of Judah, and taught the people”, we bring the book of the law wherever our people are afflicted.
